description: Moved his elbows, allowed the end, and would not let expected money eat.
name: Alice Brambleby

description: Told the hamper and the glove, asked after the twenty pounds in the same voice, laughed loudest, and paid for his own.
name: Will Kemp

description: Enjoyed the story, said the twenty pounds are expected and not his, and paid fourpence.
name: William Shakespeare
